privacy.title: Privacy · Emberwright
privacy.description: What this site and Architect Lines do with your data: nothing is collected.
privacy.intro: Emberwright collects no personal data. This page explains what still happens when you visit the site or follow its links.
privacy.site_cookies: No cookies, no analytics, no advertising, no forms.
privacy.site_fonts: Fonts, images and scripts are served by this site itself. No request goes to Google or any other third party while you read it.
privacy.site_host: The site is hosted by GitHub Pages. To deliver the pages and protect the service, GitHub logs the IP address of each visitor, as described in the GitHub General Privacy Statement. Emberwright has no access to these logs.
privacy.links: Discord and GitHub apply their own privacy policies.
privacy.mod: Architect Lines collects nothing and needs no account. Apart from the game's own multiplayer, it makes no connection. ShroudForge AL Edition, the mod loader installed with it, checks GitHub for updates when the game starts.

how.start: Hold the hammer with a 0.5 m block and aim at a block. Its material is remembered for the build.
how.aim: Look where the build should end. A blue hologram, like the game's own build preview, shows every block that will change.
how.build: The blocks are placed at once. Changed your mind? Undo {{key.keyUndo}} takes them back and restores the path, up to 20 steps.
tools.h: Pick a shape, then build or clear it
tools.lede: Every tool works in two modes: Fill places blocks, Clear removes them. Switch with {{key.keyMode}} (<kbd>A</kbd> on AZERTY).
tool.line_text: A line in 3D with no gaps, through the start, up to 32 waypoints and the end. Ramps, rails, beams.
tool.wall_text: A wall that follows your path, corners included. <kbd>Shift</kbd> with the mouse wheel sets its height, {{key.keyWallThickness}} with the wheel its width.
tool.floor_text: A flat rectangle from start to end. <kbd>Shift</kbd> with the mouse wheel makes it thicker, upwards. Floors, roofs, terraces.
tool.volume_text: Every cell of the box between start and end. In Clear mode, a room dug in one go.
tool.stack_text: One block against the face you aimed at, then one more with each press. Clear mode digs.
tool.material_text: Repaints the aimed block and every touching block of the same material.
feat.h: Build together, see it first, take it back
feat.mp: In a game hosted by a player, every player with Architect Lines can use it. The host's game applies each build, so everyone sees the same world. Each player keeps their own undo history.
feat.preview: The build is drawn where it will stand, behind the game's interface and against its terrain. Wire shows its edges through walls, Solid shows it textured with your hammer's material.
feat.levels_h: Three levels, so it stays simple
feat.levels: Start in Quick with a handful of keys. Move up when you need more. Keys above your level go back to the game.
feat.undo: Undo and redo go back 20 builds. Each one restores its start, waypoints and end, so you can rebuild the same path with another tool or material.
install.s2_h: Run it with the game closed
install.s2: It finds Enshrouded in your Steam libraries, backs up any file it replaces, then installs ShroudForge AL Edition and Architect Lines. Your saves are never touched.
install.s3: Take the hammer, choose a 0.5 m block, aim and press {{key.keyMark}}. The Architect Lines panel shows the next keys. Settings are in <kbd>F9</kbd>.
install.warn_h: Windows may warn you the first time
install.warn_smartscreen: New software has no reputation with Windows yet, so SmartScreen can show “Windows protected your PC”. Click More info, check the publisher shown below, then Run anyway.
install.warn_sac: With Smart App Control turned on, Windows may block the mod's files. The installer checks and tells you before changing anything.
edition.p1: Architect Lines runs on ShroudForge, the mod loader for Enshrouded by Bonsaibauer. A few things it needs are proposed to ShroudForge and not released yet.
edition.p2: Until they are, the installer brings ShroudForge AL Edition: the official ShroudForge plus those additions. Its F9 menu says “AL Edition”, so you always know which one you run. Once everything is in the official release, it switches back to it on its own.
edition.p3: Please report AL Edition problems on our Discord, not to the ShroudForge team.
keys.note: With the hammer in hand, these keys go to Architect Lines only, so the game does not act on them at the same time. Every key can be changed in <kbd>F9</kbd> › Architect Line › Keys.
keys.soon: The keys of the first release appear here.
keydesc.keyMark: Sets the start on the aimed block and remembers its material.
keydesc.keyVolume: Builds or clears with the chosen tool, up to the aimed block or the end point.
keydesc.keyMode: Fill places blocks, Clear removes them. <kbd>A</kbd> on AZERTY.
keydesc.keyUndo: Takes back the last build, with its path. Up to 20.
keydesc.keyRedo: Replays a build you took back.
keydesc.keyPanel: Full panel, compact line, or hidden.

faq.q_materials: Does it use materials from my inventory?
faq.a_materials: No. Architect Lines places blocks directly, like a creative tool. If you play for survival, set your own rules with your group.
faq.q_server: Does it work on a dedicated server?
faq.a_server: Not yet. It works in solo and in games hosted by a player.
faq.a_friends: Every player who wants to build with it needs it, with the same version. The installer and the updates keep everyone on the same release.
faq.a_uninstall: Windows Settings › Apps › Installed apps › Architect Lines › Uninstall. It removes only its own files and puts back what it replaced. Your saves and settings stay. You can also choose to go back to the official ShroudForge.
faq.a_data: No telemetry, no account. The only connection is the update check of the mod loader, which reads our public list of releases on GitHub.
faq.q_bug: Something went wrong. Where do I report it?
faq.a_bug: In the #beta channel of our Discord. Say what you did and what happened, and we will tell you which log files to attach.
band.p: Show it, ask for help, or tell us what to build next. Architect Lines is free, and a coffee keeps it going.
